why: I checked each command in both briefs. Builder step 5's dynamic-import one-liner, verifier Checks 1, 2 and 4, and `npm test` look valid. Verifier Check 3 breaks. Its script is wrapped in bash double quotes and contains `new RegExp('\\b'+f+'\\b')`. Bash turns `\\` into `\`, so JavaScript gets `'\b'`, which is a backspace character, not a regex word boundary. The pattern then looks for literal backspaces, never matches a README heading, and lists every export as missing, so the check fails whatever the PR does. Also, `!heads` inside double quotes can trigger history expansion in an interactive bash. So at least one command does not run as written.
